arguments.value: Andrew Lamar Carter, Jr. is a United States District Judge for the Southern District of New York, appointed by President Barack Obama in 2011 after serving as a U.S. Magistrate Judge in the Eastern District of New York from 2009 to 2011. Born in Albany, Georgia, he earned his B.A. from the University of Texas in 1991 and his J.D. from Harvard Law School in 1994. Before joining the bench, Judge Carter worked at the Ford Foundation and spent more than a decade in public interest and federal defense work in New York, including as a staff attorney at the Legal Aid Society and later as a staff and supervising attorney with the Federal Defenders of New York.
